# Unflatten From XML

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

In the Simulation profile, decode a signed I32 from a literal XML element. The I32 wired to type is a prototype, so the output is -42 even though the prototype value is 0. The example reads no file.

## What this example demonstrates

In the Simulation profile, decode a signed I32 from a literal XML element. The I32 wired to type is a prototype, so the output is -42 even though the prototype value is 0. The example reads no file.
